office: the National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA)

routes.label: in person at a NIRA office, for biometrics; collected at the place of residence

note: Uganda's missions (the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, read 2026-11-03): registration with NIRA is free, for a first registration and for renewing an expired or a lost card (the High Commission in Pretoria, undated, naming the 2025 pre-registration portal); the Embassy in Copenhagen asks 50,000 shillings for a lost card's replacement, paid to NIRA. The two missions disagree on the replacement, so it isn't modelled. The card was held free in two bands, a child's and an adult's, as the press (The Observer, Pulse Uganda) had it; the missions make no age split, so one band stands. Whether registration stays free after the 2025 drive, the card's term and the time aren't stated. NIRA's own site fails TLS verification here.

sources.title: Uganda High Commission, Pretoria (Ministry of Foreign Affairs), Visa & Consular: National ID
sources.said: Only Ugadan Citizens qualify ... Registration is FREE (First time registration, Renewal of expired or of lost National ID card) Applicants are encouraged to use the Pre-registration portal at https://prereg.nsis.nira.go.ug/pre-registration-ui/#/eng
